title: Engine: add transliteration-aware fuzzy name matching
body:
## Goal
Match names across transliterations (e.g. Mohammed/Muhammad).

## Done when
- [ ] unit tests cover 10+ variant pairs
- [ ] `screen.py eval --data data/dev` shows no unsafe clearances

title: Dashboard: show per-field match explanation for each hit
body:
## Goal
Render the engine's explanation (which fields matched, scores) next to each hit.

## Done when
- [ ] reviewer can see why a hit was escalated or cleared
